days.title: Obersee and the Southern Valley
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Obersee
stops.detail: The Obersee is a natural mountain lake in the Berchtesgaden Alps.

stops.name: Fischunkelalm
stops.detail: The 500-year-old Fischunkelalm is located on the southern shore at an altitude of 620 m and is managed by two dairymaids from mid-May to mid-October.

stops.name: Röthbachfall
stops.detail: From the 470 m high Röthwand rising behind it, the Röthbachfall plunges onto the alpine meadows, and from the adjoining Brustwand to the north, the Landtalgraben.

stops.name: Fischunkel
stops.detail: The streams join and seep into the Fischunkel, the rearmost part of the valley, and flow underground into the Obersee.

stops.name: Mittersee
stops.detail: Halfway to the Königssee, the stream widens to the south into the small Mittersee.

stops.name: Saletbach
stops.detail: The Obersee feeds the Königssee via an approximately 600 m long torrent called the Saletbach.
